posts.text: That being said, I should note that some of that unity was again found briefly after the unprecedented massacre in January, as seen with the February 14 call to action by former Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi that amassed over a million diaspora protesters around the globe.

Woman, Life, Freedom was a historic moment of unity for the Iranian diaspora. Then Oct 7 fractured that solidarity into 2 camps, and now 2 wars have further splintered the diaspora. 

It’s hard to see how those pieces can be put back together rn but finger pointing isn’t helpful.
